content: वडवा .²1 A mare; सैव भूत्वाथ वडवा नासत्यौ सुषुवे भुवि <ls>Bhāg. 6. 6. 40</ls>. .²2 The nymph Aśvinī who in the form of a mare bore to the sun two sons, the Aśvins; see संज्ञा. .²3 A female slave. .²4 A harlot, prostitute. .²5 A woman of the Brāhmaṇa caste (द्विजयोषित्). .²6 A particular constellation represented by a horseʼs head.
